"China sanctions Paraguay, Belize ministers over Taiwan ties"
BYLINE: "By AFP and Reuters" - AFP and Reuters attribution. Photo credit: Ann Wang/Reuters.

China sanctioned Paraguay's communications minister and Belize's foreign minister over ties to Taiwan. Announced MONDAY by the Chinese Ministry of Foreign Affairs, citing the safeguarding of China's national sovereignty and opposition to Taiwan separatist activities; measures took effect the same day.
NAMED: Paraguay's Communications Minister GUSTAVO VILLATE and Belize's Foreign Minister FRANCIS FONSECA.
MEASURES: freezing of their assets in China; denial of entry visas to Hong Kong and Macau; prohibition on Chinese organisations and individuals engaging in transactions, cooperation or other activities with the ministers.
China's Foreign Ministry said "certain anti-China politicians" who are "driven by self-interest" have pushed their nations to maintain diplomatic relations with Taiwan, and that the ministers had "taken a series of egregious actions and statements" which are "damaging China's core interests".
KEY FIGURE: Paraguay and Belize are TWO OF 12 COUNTRIES that maintain formal diplomatic relations with Taiwan.
Timing: two days after Taiwan's National Day. In a National Day speech outside the Presidential Office on SATURDAY, Taiwan President WILLIAM LAI CHING-TE said the island "cherishes peace" and will "not give up our freedom". China's Taiwan Affairs Office condemned Lai's speech, saying it "disregards facts, distorts the truth, misleads the public, and reveals ulterior motives".
In January, Xi Jinping pledged to achieve the "reunification" of China and Taiwan, calling the goal "unstoppable".
Villate marked Taiwan's National Day on social media: "Paraguay reaffirms its relationship of friendship and cooperation, based on shared values and principles: the self-determination of peoples, human rights and democracy."
The Belize embassy in Taiwan posted on Facebook celebrating the 37th anniversary of their diplomatic relations: "Together, we look forward to a future of growth, opportunity, and lasting friendship."
